problem_statement: The SRP server needs an additional address mode for faster start-up. When this mode is selected and the SRP server is enabled, the server must transition to the running state immediately (without waiting on the Thread Network Data publisher), adding the SRP/DNS unicast service entry directly into the Thread Network Data together with the server's mesh-local EID. On being disabled it must remove that entry directly. While in this mode, registering no service still leaves the SRP server running and the client able to discover it, and finalizing the instance must free all heap allocations. This is a new (non-spec-compliant, testing-oriented) behavior of the SRP server address mode.
